components.name: AuditQueryService (Aggregate Root)
components.description: Service that queries audit records from rigorix-engine and formats them for MCP.

components.name: ReadAuditHandler (Domain Service)
components.description: Handles `rigorix_read_audit` tool calls: retrieves audit by execution ID.

components.name: ListAuditsHandler (Domain Service)
components.description: Handles `rigorix_list_audits` tool calls: lists recent executions with filtering.

components.name: AuditSummaryHandler (Domain Service)
components.description: Handles `rigorix_audit_summary` tool calls: generates aggregate statistics.

components.name: AuditFormatter (Domain Service)
components.description: Formats audit data for MCP consumption: human-readable markdown or structured JSON.
